7.10.1.5 DTC data acqusition
[SWS_Dem_00874]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC shall return the number
of J1939 DTCs matching the defined filter criteria of
Table 7.7 for the correspond-
ing primary event memory of the requested ClientId by the function call of Dem_-
J1939DcmSetDTCFilter.
• In case the function has calculated the total number of matching DTCs, the return
value shall be E_OK.
• In case the search needs to be interrupted due to internal implementa-
tions or limitations, the return value can be set to DEM_PENDING. The out
parameter needs not to be valid in this case.
The next call of Dem_-
J1939DcmGetNumberOfFilteredDTC should continue after the interrupted el-
ement.
⌋
[SWS_Dem_01412] Setting a filter for J1939 DTCs
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04113
⌈A call of Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter shall set the filter criteria for subsequent
calls of Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredDTC.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01413] Selecting all J1939 DTCs
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04113
⌈If Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter is called with Dem_DTCKindType equal to DEM_
DTC_KIND_ALL_DTCS, the Dem shall consider all J1939 DTCs.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01414] Selecting all J1939 emission related DTCs
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04113
⌈If Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter is called with Dem_DTCKindType equal to DEM_
DTC_KIND_EMISSION_REL_DTCS, the Dem shall consider all OBD emission related
J1939 DTCs.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01415] Selecting all J1939 emission related Class_A DTCs
